items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: Mesro's Panace organized this jazz festival in Nice

ctx.x: Well, one other question about how long did you, we keep jumping around, which is all right. It doesn't have to be in special order. How long did you study with Sidney about, would you say?

Well, let's see, I started in the spring of 46. And I studied and lived with Sidney and played with him every night on the job at Ryan's until I went to, let me see, I went to France in February of 1948 with Mesro. Mesro's Panace organized this jazz festival in Nice.
